title: upfly audit --json: the result
description: The last line upfly audit --json prints when the audit runs. Progress and diagnostic lines come before it (events.json); a run that stops prints an error line instead (events.json).

exitCode.description: Always 0: what the audit finds does not change it.

savings.description: What upfly optimize would convert and save with the same folder, options and config: the plan a dry run makes, from the images the audit measured. report.summary.potentialSavingBytes counts every image measured smaller, including ones optimize would not convert. null under --no-probe, or when optimize would refuse to plan because where the site is served from is unknown.

images.description: How many images optimize would convert.

savedBytes.description: How much smaller they would be together, in bytes.

unmeasured.description: Images optimize may convert that were not measured, past --max-encodes. When above 0, optimize converts at least these images and saves at least these bytes; --probe-all measures them all.

conversions.description: Each image optimize would convert, as optimize --json lists it in its plan.

text.description: With --include-text only: the report as text, as .upfly/audit.txt holds it after an audit without --json. No file is written.

images.description: With --include-images only: every image the audit found, in path order, with its size, each reference that links it, and the kinds of finding that name it.

path.description: The image, as a path inside the project.

references.description: Each reference that links it, where it is written.

line.description: Counted from 1, or null when the file could not be read again to count it.

findings.description: The kind of each finding in report.findings that names the image.
